## Endpoints

### Data Read (5)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data for a specific entity by ID.
- `GET /api/v3/ip.json` — Get IP address information.
- `GET /sitewide_alert/load` — Retrieve sitewide alert data.
- `GET /static-scripts/v2/{v2Date}/locales/en/{enId}` — Download static script localization files.
- `GET /v3/company/details` — Retrieve detailed company information.

### Data Write (6)
- `POST /{id}` — Update an entity by ID.
- `POST /integrations/hubspot/utk/v2` — Update a HubSpot user token.
- `POST /monitoring/metrics/add/bulk/v2` — Send bulk monitoring metrics.
- `POST /monitoring/metrics/event3/bulk` — Send bulk monitoring event metrics.
- `POST /monitoring/metrics/widget/init/v3` — Initialize a monitoring widget.
- `POST /wa/` — Create or update a web application.

### Realtime (1)
- `POST /v1/events` — Send real-time event data.

### Config (1)
- `GET /web-interactives/public/v1/embed/combinedConfigs` — Get configuration for web interactives.

### Core API (2)
- `POST /targeting/evaluate_with_log` — Evaluate targeting rules with logging.
- `POST /widget_bootstrap/ping/v2` — Send a ping to the widget bootstrap service.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Bitsight's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Bitsight data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.bitsight.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Bitsight frontend uses
